statement.text:
(a) Do there exist closed non-Haken hyperbolic 3-manifolds with arbitrarily large injectivity radius?

(b) Does there exist a cofinal tower of regular covers of closed hyperbolic 3-manifolds where all of the manifolds in the tower are non-Haken?

(c) Is there a tower of hyperbolic rational homology spheres for which all fundamental groups are not left-orderable, the manifolds contain no coorientable taut foliations, or the manifolds are L-spaces? (The three properties listed are connected via the L-space conjecture. See Problem 3.48)
